title: JOINT CONSENT TO ASSIGNMENT BY UNION PACIFIC RAILROAD TO ALAMEDA BELT LINE UNDER ALAMEDA CORRIDOR DRILL TRACK AGREEMENT
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - JOINT CONSENT TO ASSIGNMENT BY UNION PACIFIC RAILROAD TO ALAMEDA BELT LINE UNDER ALAMEDA CORRIDOR DRILL TRACK AGREEMENT
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests the Board of Harbor Commissioners (Board) approve a Joint Letter of Consent (JLOC) between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department), the Port of Long Beach (POLB), the Alameda Corridor Transportation Authority (ACTA), and the Union Pacific Railroad Company (UP) (collectively referred to as “Parties) allowing UP to transfer to the Alameda Belt Line (ABL) the rights and duties for the Drill Track, under the Alameda Corridor Drill Track Use and Operating Agreement (Drill Track Agreement) dated December 31, 2002. This JLOC aids in implementing the following three objectives of the Port of Los Angeles (POLA) 2026-2030 Strategic Plan: “World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth”; “Secure, Efficient, and Environmentally Sustainable Supply Chain;” and “Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets.” Uninterrupted rail service for shippers (importers, exporters, and their intermediaries) is important for these objectives. There will be no financial impact to the Harbor Department if this JLOC is approved.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively, generally, and categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines and Section 15301 of the State CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the JLOC between the Harbor Department, POLB, ACTA, and UP to the assignment of certain rights and duties by UP under the Drill Track Agreement to ABL; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to said JLOC for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No. __________.
